messages:
sam_sales: Hey team — AureliaSystems wants a Dedicated GPU pool for a 6-week POC starting next Monday. Requirements: mix of Llama-2-70b-chat (chat-heavy) and Llama-2-13b (lighter ops), prefer H100 flavor in us-central1, target ~50 concurrent requests with p95 ~3s. Expected token volume ~1.2M tokens/day. Need VPC peering + static egress IPs + customer-managed KMS. Can we provision 4xH100 initially and allow burst to 8 if needed? Also need rough dedicated pricing for a 6-week short-term commit. CC @maria_eng @raj_infra

ops-bot: Ticket created: DEDPOOL-4821 — auto-assigned to infra-queue. ETA for first review: 24h. :white_check_mark:

maria_eng: Quick clarifying q's — are the 70b chat runs single-turn generation or multi-turn chat with long context? what's typical sequence length (tokens) per request? Also will they accept mixed-sku fallback? Mixed pools reduce cost if the 13b can handle some routes.

sam_sales: Mostly multi-turn chat, avg ~1.2k tokens per session (including history). They said they want fidelity on 70b for user-facing flows, but non-critical background tasks can go to 13b. So mixed fallback is OK but primary route must be H100-backed 70b. They want results in <500ms for short prompts but p95 3s is acceptable for heavy ones.

raj_infra: For 50 concurrent sessions at ~1.2k tokens, memory needs look large. My rough calc: a single H100 (80GB) can serve ~12-16 concurrent 70b chat sessions depending on kv-cache and quantization. So 4xH100 -> ~48-64 concurrent capacity which matches target with little headroom. For burst to 8 H100 we'll cover ~100+ concurrency. Suggest initial: 4xH100 reserved + autoscale policy to add 2 H100 on spike and allow provider-managed burst to 8. Also request customer's CIDR and required number of static egress IPs (we usually allocate 2 for NAT + control plane).

katie_se: Security checklist: they'll use customer-managed keys (CMK) — we need key IDs and KMS provider (GCP KMS or AWS KMS) and whether key is in customer project. Also ask if they need audit log forwarding and any IP whitelisting for management plane. For the POC, we can accept platform KMS if CMK not ready, but must document.

sam_sales: CMK: they prefer GCP KMS, customer will provide key resource name. CIDR: 10.40.0.0/16 (they want peer-to-peer VPC). Static egress IPs requested: 2. Billing contact: finance@aureliasystems.com. They'll sign a short-term addendum for 6 weeks.

maria_eng: Thanks — can the sales contract include a 6-week reserved rate + a short overage rate for burst? We normally offer: weekly reserved prorate on monthly commits, with burst billed at on-demand rate + 20% premium. I'll confirm final numbers but can estimate ~$14k/month per H100 for dedicated reserved (example) — need finance to price the short window properly. @sam_sales please capture whether they need SLA >99% for the POC.

sam_sales: SLA not strict for POC, they just need predictable perf. They'll accept our standard POC SLA.

raj_infra: I'll drop an initial pool config below for infra to approve. Note: replace placeholders with actual IDs.

maria_eng: please also note we should enable prefix KV caching and per-model quantization profile (70b -> q4f16 recommended) to improve density.

raj_infra: config snippet:
```
{
  "pool_name": "aurelia-poc-us-central1",
  "region": "us-central1",
  "skus": ["h100-80gb"],
  "initial_size": 4,
  "max_burst_size": 8,
  "routes": {
    "70b-chat": {"min_instances": 4, "preferred_sku": "h100-80gb"},
    "13b-ops": {"min_instances": 1, "preferred_sku": "a100-40gb", "fallback": true}
  },
  "network": {"type": "vpc-peering", "customer_cidr": "10.40.0.0/16", "static_egress_ips": ["REPLACE_WITH_IP1","REPLACE_WITH_IP2"]},
  "kms": {"provider": "gcp-kms", "key_resource": "projects/PROJECT/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/key"}
}
```

maria_eng: That looks good. I'll add autoscaling rules: scale-up on queue length and token-per-second thresholds, and enable batch sizing cap to keep p95 under 3s.

raj_infra: Next steps: I'll open infra change DEDPOOL-4821 and mark owner @raj_infra. We need customer network contact and KMS key by EOD tomorrow to meet Monday start. I'll estimate provisioning time ~48-72h after approvals and network config.

sam_sales: I've emailed the customer and asked for the KMS key + network contact. I'll update thread when they respond. Thanks everyone :pray:

ops-bot: DEDPOOL-4821 status: pending-infra-review -> assigned to raj_infra. Estimated provisioning window updated. :gear:

katie_se: Quick reminder — capture data residency note in contract (logs may transit US). If they need EU data residency we'll need private in-eu pool.

sam_sales: noted and added to the sales doc.

maria_eng: tagging for follow-up: @raj_infra please post final pricing estimate once finance confirms. :clock1:

raj_infra: Will do — target to post estimate within 6 business hours.

sam_sales: Great — closing loop for now. :thumbsup:
